BIS 925 Silver Hallmark Guide

Understanding the marks of genuine 92.5% sterling silver jewellery at MANISH & CO.

1
BIS Triangular Logo

Official hallmark stamp from the Bureau of Indian Standards.

2
925 Purity Mark

Indicates 925 parts per thousand (92.5%) pure sterling silver.

3
M&Co Sponsor Mark

Manish & Co's certified jeweler identification hallmark.

4
HUID / Assaying Center Code

Unique alphanumeric hallmarking identification code.

Every shipment arrives with a physical embossed Certificate of Authenticity signed by Manish Verma.
